title: Custom fields
page_description: Your own data on products, variants, categories, customers and orders: each field has a type, rules for its values, and a place on its record's page. Apps add fields of their own.
type_url_description: A web, email or phone link.
type_choice_description: One of a fixed set of choices.
value_decimal: Enter a number like 12.50 (a point for decimals).
value_money_list: Write each amount with its currency, like 12.50 EUR.
value_money: Enter the amount in {currency} as a number, like 18.50.
value_measurement_list: Write each measurement with its unit ({units}), like 1.5 {unit}.
value_measurement: Enter the measurement as a number, like 1.5.
problem_stale: Someone else changed this field meanwhile. Reload to see it.
card_needs_fixing: Some custom fields need fixing first.
card_hint: {owner, select, product {Your own data on this product, and what apps keep here.} variant {Your own data on this variant, and what apps keep here.} category {Your own data on this category, and what apps keep here.} customer {Your own data on this customer, and what apps keep here.} other {Your own data on this order, and what apps keep here.}} <link>Manage fields</link>
input_list_money: Each amount with its currency, like 12.50 EUR.
variant_dialog_subtitle: Saved at once, apart from the product's other changes.
list_order_hint: Shown on each of their pages in this order.
list_order_hint_read_only: Shown on each of their pages in this order. Changing fields needs the custom_fields:write scope.
suggested_description: Fields Hypha knows what to do with: the admin shows them in place, and apps expect them by these names. Add the ones you want; change or delete them like any other.
delete_dialog_description: Every value of {field} goes with it, on every record, and it can't be undone. Filters and integrations using it stop working.
error_key: The key is 2 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
error_min_length: The minimum length is a whole number.
error_max_length: The maximum length is a whole number.
error_max_scale: The number of decimals is a whole number.
error_min_items: The minimum number of items is a whole number.
error_max_items: The maximum number of items is a whole number.
error_min_whole: The minimum is a whole number.
error_max_whole: The maximum is a whole number.
error_min_minor_units: The minimum is a whole number of minor units (cents).
error_max_minor_units: The maximum is a whole number of minor units (cents).
error_min_measurement: The minimum is a number with its unit, like 1.5 {unit}.
error_max_measurement: The maximum is a number with its unit, like 1.5 {unit}.
error_choices_incomplete: Give every choice a key and a label.
dialog_new_subtitle: Its key and type can't change later.
dialog_edit_subtitle: {field} · {type}. Its key and type can't change.
dialog_name_hint: What staff see on the form.
dialog_key_hint: Code reads it as custom.{key}: lowercase letters, digits and _.
dialog_storefront_hint: Whether storefronts can read the value.
dialog_filterable_hint: Offered as a filter on the list, and usable as a search filter.
dialog_unique_hint: No two records hold the same value (text ignoring case).
dialog_personal_hint: About a person (a birthday, a gift message): hidden from apps and keys without customer_data:profile.
bound_hint_money: In minor units (cents), in the value's currency.
rule_pattern_hint: A regular expression the whole value matches, like [A-Z]'{3}'-\d+ (no look-around or back-references).
rule_dimension_hint: Required. Values take any unit of it.
rule_schemes_hint: Any of them when none is chosen.
rule_domains_hint: Comma-separated, like example.com, shop.example.com. Any when empty.
rule_currencies_hint: Any currency when none is chosen.
rule_kind_hint: Required: what the value points at.
choices_hint: Keys are lowercase letters, digits, _ and -; they're what's stored, so they can't change once saved. Labels are what staff and shoppers see.
